name: MonarchAvatar
title: Avatar
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.Image (through the internal MonarchImage) clipped to a shape, androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicText with TextAutoSize for the initials, androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row with negative spacing for MonarchAvatarGroup
summary: A picture of a person or an entity, with initials or an icon as the fallback, an optional presence dot, and an overlapping group with a "+N" tile.
whenToUse: Next to a person's or an organization's name in lists, comments, assignees and headers; the group for the people on one item.
whenNotToUse: For the people in a live session with a list of everyone use MonarchPresenceAvatars. For an AI agent use MonarchAiAgentAvatar. For a file use MonarchFileTypeIcon.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchAvatar(image: Painter?, name: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, shape: MonarchAvatarShape = MonarchAvatarShape.Circle, size: MonarchAvatarSize = MonarchAvatarSize.Md, status: MonarchPresenceStatus? = null, seed: String? = null, decorative: Boolean = false, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, statusLabel: String? = null)

@Composable public fun MonarchAvatar(image: @Composable () -> Unit, name: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, shape: MonarchAvatarShape = MonarchAvatarShape.Circle, size: MonarchAvatarSize = MonarchAvatarSize.Md, status: MonarchPresenceStatus? = null, decorative: Boolean = false, statusLabel: String? = null)

@Composable public fun <T> MonarchAvatarGroup(items: List<T>, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, maxVisible: Int? = null, size: MonarchAvatarSize = MonarchAvatarSize.Md, shape: MonarchAvatarShape = MonarchAvatarShape.Circle, overflowLabel: ((Int) -> String)? = null, avatar: @Composable (T) -> Unit)
public enum class MonarchAvatarSize { Xs, Sm, Md, Lg, Xl }
public enum class MonarchAvatarShape { Circle, Square }

options.name: image
options.description: The picture, loaded by the app (a resource, a BitmapPainter, Coil's rememberAsyncImagePainter). null shows the fallback, which also stands for loading and failure. The slot overload lets the app compose the picture itself; it is clipped to the shape.

options.name: name
options.description: The person or entity. Read by TalkBack and used for the initials.

options.name: shape
options.description: Circle for people, Square (rounded) for workspaces, organizations and brands.

options.name: size
options.description: 20, 24, 32, 40 or 56dp at the default font size, multiplied by the font scale.

options.name: status
options.description: A MonarchPresenceDot with a surface-coloured ring at the bottom end corner; its name is added to what TalkBack reads.

options.name: seed
options.description: Painter overload: picks the fallback color; the name by default. Pass a stable id so a renamed person keeps their color.

options.name: decorative
options.description: Hides the avatar from TalkBack when the name is written next to it.

options.name: icon
options.description: Painter overload: shown instead of the initials when there is no picture, for an entity without a logo. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: statusLabel
options.description: Replaces the spoken name of the presence; the built-in strings are those of MonarchPresenceDot.

options.name: items (group)
options.description: The people or entities of the group, in order.

options.name: label (group)
options.description: Names the group for TalkBack, for example "Assignees".

options.name: maxVisible (group)
options.description: Show at most this many avatars, then a "+N" tile. With exactly one too many, all are shown.

options.name: overflowLabel (group)
options.description: Replaces the spoken "N more" of the tile.

options.name: avatar (group)
options.description: The avatar of one item; give it the size and shape of the group.

states.name: picture
states.description: The picture fills the shape, cropped.

states.name: initials
states.description: No picture: one or two initials on a subtle fill picked from the seed, in the strong color of the same family.

states.name: icon
states.description: With icon, the icon on the same colors instead of the initials.

states.name: no readable initials
states.description: An empty name or one without letters or digits, and no icon: the color alone. TalkBack still reads the name as given.

states.name: presence
states.description: A presence dot ringed in the surface color at the bottom end corner.

states.name: group overflow
states.description: A "+N" tile in the muted colors after the shown avatars, each ringed in the surface color.

appearance: Fallbacks use five pairs of theme roles, each a subtle fill with the strong text of one family (accent, info, success, warning, AI), so they follow light, dark and both high-contrast themes; danger is left out. The tile uses the muted background with muted text, and the ring the surface color.
platformNotes: The web derives a soft color from a hue per name, or one of five data colors with palette="tokens"; Android, as iOS, always uses five theme role pairs, picked with the web's hash so a seed lands on the same index. The web's xs and xl sizes and pixel sizes are not offered: the touch vocabulary is Sm, Md and Lg. Monarch ships no image loader on Android, so the picture is a Painter or a slot rather than a URL, and a failed load is the app passing null. Monarch bundles no icons, so the person glyph of the web is not drawn: without an icon a name without letters shows the color alone. The presence uses MonarchPresenceStatus, which adds do not disturb to the web's four. AvatarGroup on the web counts its children; Compose cannot count slot children, so the group takes the items and a composable per item, as on iOS.
accessibility: The avatar is one TalkBack element with the image role, named by the name, and by the presence when there is one ("Ana Silva, Online"); the initials and the dot are not read on their own.
decorative = true hides the avatar from TalkBack when the name is written beside it.
The presence dot keeps its forms (bar, ring, and in high contrast half and square), so presence does not depend on color.
The group is a traversal group named by its label; each avatar is read by its own name, then the tile as "2 more".
The avatar grows with the font size setting, and the initials shrink to fit rather than being cut.
Avatars are not interactive, so they have no touch target; wrap one in a button when it must act.
edgeCases: Initials keep whole characters, so an emoji or a letter with a combining accent is never cut in half.
An empty name gives no initials; give decorative = true or a name, since TalkBack reads the name as given.
In a group, give each avatar the same size and shape as the group; the group uses them for the overlap, the ring and the tile.
The same seed gives the same color on Android, iOS and the web.
